name: mirage
text:
Novig slowed again because a new engine runner started at 03:58 UTC and Novig refused the read-only key again (401, 'doesn't know that key ID'). The runner that restarted at 03:10 had accepted it. I can't see why the new one is refused without reading the key, so I don't know the cause. Please tap Settings › Cloud scan › Send a Novig read-only key once more, and don't tap any other key-send button until it works. I'll restart the engine after.

Where the money went (the engine's own settled orders since Oct 17):
- Bids make money: +$32 on 1,358 fills, +5.8% on money staked.
- Taker bets lose: -$29 on 533 bets, -3.3%. Almost all of it is ATP tennis: -$52 on 194 bets (-14%), with ATP game totals -17%, ATP favorite spreads -12% and ATP moneylines -24%. The two worst days were Oct 26 and Oct 28.
- WTA is about break-even (+2%). Non-tennis taker bets are +8.5%, and moneylines are +27% over a small sample.
- I can't call ATP a proven leak yet. The 95% range on the ATP result still includes zero (-34% to +6%), and it's 194 bets against the 200 my own rules require before I change a rule. At 200+ I'll cut or tighten ATP taker bets.

Duplicate or similar bets: not the main problem. The most orders on one game in the last 2 days was 7, mostly small bids, for $2-$10 in total. The $5 cap on similar bets together is in force, and the engine is holding back about 1,500 bids for repeat-guard reasons at any moment.

Sketchy small books in the fair: I haven't verified this yet. What I did see is that the losing ATP bets had 4-13 books behind the fair, and bets with only 4 books lost more (-13%) than bets with 6 or more (+5%). The fair is anchored to Pinnacle and other sharp books, but the minimum is only 2 books, so thin fairs can get through. Next I'll break the ATP losses down by which books made each fair. I haven't changed any setting yet.
